mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: vector.local)

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

headerTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for response headers. Provider integrations may set defaults. Set to false to disable timeout.

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider. If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted.

concurrency.description: How many requests Vector sends to this provider's server at once. Providers that point at one server share its limit. Without it, a server on this computer or your network takes one at a time. Check models sets it for the servers it finds.

forwards.description: Whether this provider's server passes prompts on to other services, as a LiteLLM proxy does. Its steps then count as unpriced rather than local, so a dollar cap still stops them. Check models sets it for a LiteLLM proxy.

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for connecting to the MCP server and listing its tools (default 30000) and for each request to it, tool calls included (default experimental.mcp_timeout, else 60000).

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

callbackPort.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server (default: 19876). Shorthand for redirectUri when only the port needs changing. Ignored if redirectUri is set.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for connecting to the MCP server and listing its tools (default 30000) and for each request to it, tool calls included (default experimental.mcp_timeout, else 60000).

auto_resize.description: Resize images before sending them to the model when they exceed configured limits (default: true)

max_width.description: Maximum image width before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_height.description: Maximum image height before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_base64_bytes.description: Maximum base64 payload bytes for an image attachment (default: 5242880)

kind.description: The kind of server Vector found, such as ollama or vllm

models.description: A hash of the model list when it was added

spki.description: SHA-256 of an https server's public key when it was added

enabled.description: Run Vector's AI features only on the model servers in endpoints (default: false)

web.description: What web pages and searches may reach with Vector Local on: ask (sites you approve), network (your network and sites your company lists) or none. Default: ask.

endpoints.description: Origins of the model servers Vector may send prompts to, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434. Wildcard hosts (https://*.ml.corp.example.com) and address ranges (10.0.0.0/8) are read from managed config only.

web_domains.description: Sites web pages may always reach (allow) or never reach (deny) with Vector Local on

allow.description: Services you allowed with Vector Local on, each with the reason you gave

pins.description: The identity each model server had when it was added, by origin

checked.description: Results of Check models, by provider/model

ca.description: Certificate files added to the system and default certificates

log.description: How long the network log is kept on this computer (default: 30 days)

lock.description: Managed only: the managed block is authoritative and Vector Local stays on

user_may.description: Managed only: keys a user may still change under a lock (web only to a stricter setting)

locked_keys.description: Managed only: other config keys a user may not change under a lock

endpoint_domains.description: Managed only: patterns that endpoints a user adds must match under a lock

updates.description: Managed only: a company mirror for updates

models_dir.description: Managed only: a folder holding the memory-search and dictation model files

catalog_path.description: Managed only: a model catalog file to use instead of downloading one

recommend.description: Managed only: replaces the bundled model recommendations

depth.description: Focused: one agent, plus up to 2 researchers when the question has independent parts. Deep: up to 4 researchers and a citation judge (default: auto)

tool.description: When the build agent may research as a tool on its own requests: work (Work and Thorough requests), thorough (Thorough only) or off. Default: work. A repository's config may only turn it down.

limits.description: Caps for one research run, used when you have no spend cap of your own. Read from your user config only.

domains.description: Sites research prefers or avoids. A repository's config may only add to avoid.

robots.description: Respect robots.txt for links Vector finds itself (default: true). Read from your user config only.

retain_days.description: Days an unkept research run stays in the brain (default: 30)

search.description: @deprecated Research searches the web in each research agent's own browser in the desktop app, with no search service or key; this setting is ignored.

browser_search.description: @deprecated Research always searches in each research agent's own browser in the desktop app; this setting is ignored.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

shell.description: Default shell to use for terminal and bash tool

server.description: Server configuration for vector serve and web commands

size.description: How much harness the command's run gets: chat, light, standard or thorough. When unset, the run is standard unless the user's arguments ask for thorough. Standard and thorough may hand work to subagents; light and chat do not.

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

references.description: Named git or local directory references

reference.description: @deprecated Use 'references' field instead. Named git or local directory references

snapshot.description: Enable or disable snapshot tracking. When false, filesystem snapshots are not recorded and undoing or reverting will not undo/redo file changes. Defaults to true.

share.description: Public session sharing is unavailable in Vector; this setting is ignored.

autoshare.description: @deprecated Public session sharing is unavailable in Vector; this setting is ignored.

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

formatter.description: Enable or configure formatters. Omit or set to false to disable, true to enable built-ins, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

lsp.description: Enable or configure LSP servers. Omit or set to false to disable, true to enable built-ins, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

attachment.description: Attachment processing configuration, including image size limits and resizing behavior

max_lines.description: Maximum lines of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 2000)

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 51200)

tool_output.description: Thresholds for truncating tool output. When output exceeds either limit, the full text is written to the truncation directory and a preview is returned.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Clear old tool outputs when a prompt arrives after the provider's prompt cache has expired, when the history is re-sent at full price anyway (default: true)

tail_turns.description: Number of recent user turns, including their following assistant/tool responses, to keep verbatim during compaction (default: 2)

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens from recent turns to preserve verbatim after compaction

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

max_context.description: Compact once the conversation reaches this many tokens, even when the model's window is larger. Every request re-sends the whole conversation, so a smaller context costs less per step. Defaults to just below a model's long-context price tier, and to 200000 for models with a window of 500000 or more and no tier; 0 uses the model's whole window.

clear.description: During a long run, clear old tool outputs once the context passes 60000 tokens and at least 40000 tokens of older output can go (default: false)

enabled.description: Stop runs that repeat the same tool call or error (default: true)

running.description: Subagents that run at once in one conversation; the rest wait for a free slot (default: 8)

per_request.description: New subagents one request may start, at any depth (default: 32)

subagents.description: Limits for the subagents one request starts: how many run at once in a conversation (running), how many one request may start (per_request), and the spend ceiling they share (usd, default 25 at catalog prices; only priced and unknown steps count toward it). A repository may only lower running and per_request, and its usd is ignored.

concurrency.description: Agents of one run working at once, also bounded by this computer's processors (default: 16)

usd.description: Spend ceiling of one run at catalog prices (default: none; the subagent ceiling still applies)

tokens.description: Tokens one run may use (default: none)

steps.description: Model steps of one run (default: 40 per agent)

runs.description: Workflow runs at once in one conversation (default: 1)

workflow.description: Ceilings of a workflow run. A repository may only lower them.

budget.description: Spend and runaway limits. run applies to every run in every repository: set it in your user config, because a repository's own budget.run is ignored. A prompt's own budget overrides run.

auto.description: Size each request, so a greeting gets a direct reply and a small action is done directly: Work and Thorough requests may hand work to subagents; Light and Chat do not (default: true). false gives every request the full harness.

judge.description: When Vector runs LLM-as-a-judge after a run that changed files: off, thorough (large tasks only) or changes (every task that changed files). Default: off for those runs. A prompt's own judge setting overrides it. Deep research's citation judge reads it too, and runs when it is unset: unset or thorough checks Deep reports and Focused ones that cite 8 or more notes, changes checks every report, and off turns it off.

learn.description: Use learned workflow defaults when you leave effort on Default: drop Thorough's extra effort, skip subagents or give them a cheaper model, only where this repository's checked runs passed as often for less (default: true). false keeps the size's defaults. Your own picks always win, and spend caps are unchanged.

fork.description: Let the agent start subagents from its whole conversation, sharing its prompt cache (default: true)

models.description: Models a subagent may be given that cost more than the agent's own or run on another provider: "provider/model" entries. "provider/*" and "*" only widen which providers count; the cost rule still applies.

ask_timeout.description: Minutes a subagent's permission request or question waits for you before it is declined, never approved (default: it waits)

lsp.description: Start language servers in a subagent's own worktree (default: false)

mcp.description: Start local MCP servers in a subagent's own worktree (default: false)

link.description: Git-ignored directories, such as node_modules, linked into a subagent's own worktree

max_kept.description: Changed worktrees kept waiting for your review (default: 20)

isolation.description: Worktrees of subagents launched with isolation

subagents.description: How subagents run: forks, per-call models, how long a helper's unanswered request waits, and worktree isolation. Read from your user config; a repository may only turn forks off, narrow models and shorten your ask_timeout.

sizing.description: Task sizing: how much harness, reasoning and verification each request gets.

local.description: Vector Local: run Vector's AI features only on model servers you or your company host. Read from your user config and your company's managed config, never a repository's.

research.description: Deep research (preview): when the build agent may research as a tool, what one run may spend and read, the sites it prefers or avoids, and robots.txt. Research searches the web in each research agent's own browser in the desktop app; there is no search service to set up. depth and retain_days do not apply yet. Read from your user config; a repository's config may only add sites to avoid and turn the research tool down.

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

policies.description: Policy statements applied to supported resources, such as provider access
